messages.message: Current state of the Batch Decay tool.
The time to decay to. Units of s, m, h, d, or y are accepted. A negative time (e.g. "-48h") looks backwards instead, solving for the activities the inputs must have had that long ago.
Number of time points to evaluate, from time zero to the decay time. A value of 1 evaluates only at the decay time.

Optional lower cut on the results: any activity below this is left out of the output. Given as a plain number with no units, compared against the value as shown in the result table (so it is in whatever activity units the results are in). Gamma, x-ray, alpha and beta lines are counts per second rather than activities, so the cut does not apply to them. Leave blank for no cut.

Sum all input nuclides into a single mixture and co-decay them (implies showing progeny). This lets the decay progeny of different ultimate parents mix together and be reported as a single line per nuclide. If not selected, each input is decayed on its own, so a progeny reached from more than one input is reported separately for each parent.
Fixed while a multi-location file is loaded: the nuclides of each location are always co-decayed as one mixture, and values from different locations are never combined.
Also output the activity of every decay-progeny nuclide.
Drop or click to upload a CSV of nuclides.
